is_anopheles.evidence: Study tests four laboratory strains of Anopheles gambiae s.s. (Page 2, 'Mosquito strains').

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyped Vgsc L1014F (Vgsc L995F / kdrR) and Ace-1 G119S (Ace-1 G280S / ace-1R) using molecular PCR assays (Page 3, 'Mosquito strains').

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No extractable field population genotype frequency data; only fixed laboratory strains (KISUMU, ACERKIS, KISKDR, ACERKDRKIS) were used (Page 2-3).

african_field_population.evidence: The study exclusively used laboratory reference strains (KISUMU, ACERKIS, KISKDR) and a laboratory-crossed homozygous strain (ACERKDRKIS). No wild field-collected mosquitoes from Africa were evaluated (Page 2-3).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical laboratory study evaluating bioassay and biochemical phenotypic effects of resistance alleles (Page 1-3).

sub_country_location.evidence: No field collection locations because only laboratory strains were tested.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field collection dates or years reported as only laboratory strains were used.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Laboratory strain study with no field sample dataset overlap.

supplement.evidence: No supplementary data needed; all laboratory bioassay results are reported in the main text.

assessment.summary: This laboratory study evaluated the phenotypic and biochemical effects of concomitant kdr-west (Vgsc L995F) and ace-1R (Ace-1 G280S) resistance mutations using four homozygous reference/derived strains of Anopheles gambiae s.s. (KISUMU, ACERKIS, KISKDR, and ACERKDRKIS). Because the study relied entirely on laboratory colony strains and contains no field-collected African mosquito populations, it does not meet the eligibility criteria.
exclusion_reasons: african_field_population: Only laboratory strains (KISUMU, ACERKIS, KISKDR, ACERKDRKIS) were tested; no field-collected African mosquito populations were evaluated.
reports_extractable_genotype_data: No extractable field population genotype counts or frequencies are reported.
